name: Polk County, OR
findings: Polk County has 236 nonprofit organizations. 102 of them (43%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 76 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (29% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, Polk County has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Religious organizations stand out for public events
observations.text: 21 religious organizations here list public events, compared with about 10 in similar places of this size.

confidence.text: Based on 21 organizations here; 41% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: What role do religious organizations play in community life here? Who do they reach, and who might they miss?

observations.title: Social and fraternal organizations that list no opportunities
observations.text: 16 social and fraternal organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity on their websites. Many may still offer them without saying so online, or have no website at all.
